name: Technical Support
blurb: Solve customers' technical problems with a product or service, by phone, chat or ticket.

name: Systems Administrator
blurb: Keep servers, user accounts, backups and core IT systems running.

name: SOC / Cybersecurity Analyst
blurb: Watch security alerts, investigate incidents and help keep systems protected.

name: IT Support Specialist
blurb: Support staff inside a company: laptops, accounts, software, printers and network access.

name: Network, NOC & Telecom
blurb: Install, monitor and fix networks, network equipment and telecom lines.

name: Application Support
blurb: Support business applications: troubleshoot issues, run fixes and work with developers.

name: Help Desk, Service Desk & Desktop Support
blurb: First point of contact for IT problems: tickets, password resets, setting up computers.

name: Technology Analyst
blurb: General IT analyst roles that mix support, systems and small projects.

name: Systems Support
blurb: Support and maintain specific business systems and the people who use them.

name: Software / Product Support
blurb: Help customers use and troubleshoot a software product.
